dedupe_keys.name: a geospatial database of close to reality travel times to obstetric emergency care in 15 nigerian conurbations

description: A geospatial database of close-to-reality travel times to obstetric emergency care in 15 Nigerian conurbations is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Peter M. Macharia et al. Travel time estimation accounting for on-the-ground realities between the location where a need for emergency obstetric care (EmOC) arises and the health facility capable of providing EmOC is essential for improving pregnancy outcomes. Coverage: national (NG); published in 2023. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 904770 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
